content.title: What turning AI compute into a financial asset would look like
content.description:
What exactly does it mean when investors want to "financialize" AI computing, a.k.a, turning it into a liquid financial asset or market?

The Economist's Wall Street editor Mike Bird speaks with Julie Hyman and helps explain all the moving parts to this potential scenario, including the factors that may dictate pricing for renting compute chips around the world.
